description: This file contains functions for building and managing agent graphs in a workflow, including compiling multi-agent and sequential agent graphs, handling node initialization, conditional edges, and streaming results in a complex AI agent orchestration system.

methods.name: buildAgentGraph
methods.description: Main function to build and stream the agent workflow graph, handling multi-agent and sequential modes, managing agent reasoning, source documents, tools, and streaming responses.

methods.name: compileMultiAgentsGraph
methods.description: Constructs a multi-agent workflow graph, initializes worker and supervisor nodes, manages conditional and tool edges, and returns a streaming result.

methods.name: compileSeqAgentsGraph
methods.description: Constructs a sequential agent workflow graph with conditionals, interruptions, and tool integrations, returning a stream of the execution.

methods.name: getSortedDepthNodes
methods.description: Sorts nodes based on their depth in the queue for processing order.
